strategies.label: Naive
strategies.note: One separate on-chain Groth16/SP1 verification per AI inference. Gas = N × 327,621.

strategies.label: SnarkPack
strategies.note: Batch N same-circuit Groth16 proofs into one aggregated verification. Bowe et al. 2020. Gas ≈ 280k + 60k × ⌈log₂ N⌉. Prover time: seconds.

strategies.label: ZK Recursion
strategies.note: Verify N proofs inside a RISC-V program, wrap once in SP1/Groth16. Gas is constant regardless of N. Prover time grows O(N) — minutes to hours for large batches.
